en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard depicting the central market square (Markt) of a small German town. Prominently in the middle stands a three-story building with a clock tower and cupola, bearing the inscription "KOENIGLICHES AMTSGERICHT" on its facade, indicating a royal district court. Horse-drawn carts, several townspeople, and leafless trees line the cobbled square. Older townhouses frame the square, and church towers are visible in the background. The printed caption at the top left reads "Geithain. Markt." and a vertical imprint along the left edge gives the publisher and year.
